title: THE UNWRITTEN ALIBI
summary: 書庫から消えた一通の封筒。記録と鍵を質問し、証言を疑い、最後に一度だけ結論を出す。
mechanicalObligations: A new session instantiates its own consistent hidden case
Hearing testimony does not establish its truth
Access and key records precede the final decision
A final decision is irreversible; both supported and unsupported endings are valid
editorialObligations: The distinction between allegation and proof stays legible
